subject: SOC2 recert & retention amendment — Novus renewal (timeline + MAP)

Subject: SOC2 recert & retention needs for renewal

Hi Mateo / Kim,

As we prep Novus' annual renewal (targeting 2026-03-15 execution), our compliance team flagged two items that need to be confirmed for the contract amendment:

1) SOC 2 recert timeline — we need Redwood's updated attestation date and confirmation that the report will cover the period ending on or after 2026-02-28.

2) Log retention — our regulators are requiring 24 months of audit log retention for this product line (we currently have 12 months in the contract). We need a proposed contract amendment that extends retention to 730 days, and the associated pricing and SLA for log access/exports (audit window requests may be up to 72 hours for raw logs).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide: the expected recertification evidence bundle (S3 transfer or drive link), a proposed amendment outlining the retention change and associated monthly uplift, and an updated MAP with delivery milestones?

If possible, please include a DocuSign link for the amendment so procurement can circulate internally. We are also evaluating a modest capacity uplift (extra burst capacity for end-of-month reporting) — would you include an optional line item for a dedicated burst allocation (30% for 3 months) in the pricing sheet?

Thanks,
Alyssa Monroe
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
Novus Bank
alyssa.monroe@novusbank.com

Attachment: Novus_requirements_2026-02.pdf (reference only)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we can support the 24-month (730-day) retention amendment and deliver the SOC 2 recert evidence bundle in a way that meets your audit team's ingest requirements.

Proposed approach (high level):
- Evidence bundle: we'll assemble the SOC 2 workpapers and evidence artifacts and stage them in a secured S3 bucket (read-only snapshot) and also provide a Drive mirror. Delivery ETA: within 7 business days of your go-ahead.
- Log retention amendment: we will prepare a redline to extend retention to 730 days and add a retention-access SLA (72-hour extraction window). Monthly uplift: estimate provided by Sales (pricing sheet to follow).
- Burst capacity: we'll include an optional 3-month dedicated burst allocation (30% capacity) as a separable line item.
- MAP: I'll put together a mutual action plan with milestones: evidence prep, proofing call, S3 handoff, amended Exhibit B (retention), DocuSign routing, and go-live.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm Novus accepts the 730-day retention target and the 72-hour extraction SLA.
2) We will produce the evidence checklist (attached) and a first draft of the amendment + pricing within 48 hours.
3) Schedule a short proofing call for the evidence bundle (30 minutes).

I've attached our recert checklist and log transfer instructions to streamline evidence ingestion.

If that works I will loop in Sales/Finance to finalize the pricing sheet and DocuSign link.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
